title: Release audit: The session keeps unredacted engine text in memory. `show_state` assigns the raw
summary: Store the redacted form, or a hash, for comparison and deduplication, and never assign raw engine text to long-lived session attributes.
requirements: Any text produced by the engine that the client keeps in memory for the session is masked before it is kept, so the in-memory copy never contains a value the client would mask on screen.
The retained state text shown by the state display is the masked text; repeating the display later does not reveal the secret.
The retained idle-refresh failure text is masked before retention, and any later display of that failure shows only the mask.
Masking applies equally to engine answers and engine error messages.
Text that carries no key material is retained and shown unchanged, apart from the masking applied today.
Masking an already-masked retained text leaves it unchanged: no second marker appears and no content is lost.
What the user sees on a later repeat of retained text equals what the client retained; there is no path where the retained copy is more revealing than the display.
No other client behavior changes, and the existing test suite passes.
acceptance: When the engine returns an answer whose text contains key material, nothing the client retains for the session contains that value in readable form; the user sees only the mask.
When the engine fails with an error message containing key material, the failure text the client retains and any later display of it contain only the mask.
An answer or error without key material is retained and shown exactly as before.
Masking retained text a second time yields the same text, with one marker per masked value.
Repeating a retained state or failure display later shows the same masked text that was retained.

external_dependencies.name: Forgel engine commands
external_dependencies.interface: Invoke the Forgel engine command interface exposed by the project’s `main` application repository: pass a command name and parameters, receive the returned text answer, and on failure catch the engine error and read `message`. Both the text and the error message must be masked before retention.
external_dependencies.docs: Project repository list; FORGEL.md — Runtime Process Model and D-108.
external_dependencies.evidence: The project repository contract lists the Forgel application repositories (`main: application`, `code: application`). FORGEL.md states the runtime is code-owned in `src/forgel/runtime_model.py` and that runtime operations are directly available (D-108: `drive`, `task ...`, `release ...`). The task dependency contract defines the engine invocation result as a text answer or an error `message`.
